_comment: FORMAT EXAMPLE ONLY. The engine loads a priors file only when RESEARCH_PRIORS_PATH points at it, and it ignores every entry that is not review_status=reviewed AND has at least one citation. A reviewed prior acts only as a direction-concordance gate (an association that contradicts it cannot pass ERL-2 observationally). It never changes a p-value or effect estimate. Do not add medical claims here without a reviewer and citations.
